doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

title: The ball and a singer in Creole
summary: Allen missed the ball; Edna mentions a man who sang in Creole.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: You didn't go to the ball? No, I'm afraid I went to bed that night.
I was, I was really tired. Yeah.
Oh, well you missed a lot. And, uh, that, uh, those, um, what his name was Tom, uh, that sang in, in Creole.
Oh yeah. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy.
